modern: How unsound and insincere is the man who says, I have decided to deal with you fairly!—What are you doing, man? There is no need to give this notice. It will soon show itself in actions. The voice ought to be plainly written on the forehead. Whatever a man’s character is, he shows it at once in his eyes, just as the one who is loved at once reads everything in the eyes of his lovers. The man who is honest and good ought to be exactly like a man who smells strong, so that anyone standing by, as soon as he comes near him, must smell it whether he wants to or not. But a pretence of simplicity is like a crooked stick. Nothing is more disgraceful than a wolf’s friendship, a false friendship. Avoid this above all. The good and simple and kindly show all these things in their eyes, and there is no mistaking it.
original: How unsound and insincere is he who says, I have determined to deal with thee in a fair way!—What are thou doing, man? There is no occasion to give this notice. It will soon show itself by acts. The voice ought to be plainly written on the forehead. Such as a man’s character is, he immediately shows it in his eyes, just as he who is beloved forthwith reads everything in the eyes of lovers. The man who is honest and good ought to be exactly like a man who smells strong, so that the bystander as soon as he comes near him must smell whether he choose or not. The good and simple and benevolent show all these things in the eyes, and there is no mistaking.

explained.summary:
Real honesty doesn’t need announcing. When someone says they’ve decided to be straight with you, it’s a bad sign: genuine fairness shows itself in actions and in the face, the way a lover can read everything in the eyes of the beloved. A good person should be as unmistakable as a strong smell, noticed whether you want to or not.

Faked simplicity is like a crooked stick, and the worst thing of all is false friendship, which Marcus calls a wolf’s friendship. Avoid it above everything.
explained.today: Be wary of the colleague who starts with ’to be totally honest with you’ or the salesperson who keeps saying ’I’m not here to sell you anything’. The people you trust most rarely tell you they’re trustworthy; you just notice over time that they are.
